title: Two-Tape Movement Action
statement: Let $r_1,r_2$ be work-tape indices, let $v\in\{-1,0,1\}$, and let $s$ be a state. The action leaves the input head stationary, writes nothing and moves each of the two indexed work-tape heads by $v$, leaves every other work-tape head stationary without writing, emits no output symbol, and enters state $s$.
